cb04299a7e43793ad4a898ba7e46f4bc3163c4c0.summary: Appgate Labs analysed Egregor, a new ransomware family that it says seems to be a Sekhmet spin-off. The report describes an operator that hacks companies, steals data, encrypts files and threatens to leak stolen data. A deep-web leak site listed at least 13 companies, including the logistics firm GEFCO. The ransom note sets a 3-day deadline.
